answer: The potter's wheel turns all day, and every pot that leaves it bears the thrower's thumbprint in the clay. Proof of potter jar via kiln firing tally is the throwing: a jar the potter fires only after 26 pots are thrown, each pot shaped on the same wheel. The ripple is the first pot, thrown when the clay was wedged; the pulse is the last, thrown when the kiln was lit. A cheat must throw 21 false pots and light 21 false kilns, and the canyon still fires no jar worth keeping.
